name: FedEx
rationale: Outbound shipments to customers -> 63200. Mail & Copy resale of carrier services -> 51300 (COGS). Inbound freight on inventory -> 52000.

name: UPS
rationale: Same treatment as FedEx. Short keyword: refine to "UPS*" if it hits words like GROUPS.

name: Procore
rationale: Annual contract paid upfront -> 13000 Prepaid Expenses, amortize monthly to 62400.

name: Sage
rationale: Subscription software. Keyword is "SAGE SOFTWARE" to avoid matching words like USAGE.

name: LoopNet
rationale: Paid listings are advertising (63000); source template groups it with CRM software.

name: ConnectWise
rationale: Internal tooling -> 62400. Seats re-billed to clients -> 51000 COGS.

name: Datto
rationale: Internal use -> 62400. Backup resold to clients -> 51000 COGS.

name: Westlaw
rationale: Research subscription. Bank descriptor may read THOMSON REUTERS / WEST - add as alias row if needed.

name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
rationale: Internal hosting -> 62400. Hosting resold to clients (MSP) -> 51300 COGS.

name: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts
rationale: Sales tax remittances clear 22000 Sales Tax Payable. Franchise tax payments -> override 72000. Timely-filing discount -> 49000.

name: Texas Workforce Commission
rationale: Quarterly SUTA payment. If SUTA is accrued through payroll, use override 23000 instead.

name: County Appraisal District / Tax Assessor-Collector
rationale: Business personal property tax -> 62100; real property -> override 62200. Payment goes to county tax assessor-collector.

name: Internal Revenue Service (IRS)
rationale: EFTPS 941/940 deposits clear 23000 Payroll Liabilities (employer share expensed to 61100 when payroll is booked).

name: Gusto
rationale: Service fee only. Net-pay debits -> 61000; tax debits -> 23000 (use override).

name: Amazon (Marketplace)
rationale: Most common use is supplies; inventory -> 51000/12000, equipment -> 15000.

name: USPS
rationale: Postage. Shipments of product to customers -> 63200.

name: Uline
rationale: Mail & Copy packing materials for resale -> 51000.

name: Apple Store
rationale: Capitalize if above your policy threshold (de minimis safe harbor $2,500/item); else 62600. Apple.com/bill subscriptions -> 62400.

name: Google Ads
rationale: Descriptor often GOOGLE*ADS - add that text as an alias row if it does not match.

name: Uber
rationale: Uber rides. Uber Eats is a separate, more specific vendor (63110).

name: Square
rationale: Fees only. Deposits are revenue (41000/41100) - record gross sales, fees separately.

name: PayPal
rationale: Fees -> 54000. PayPal payments TO vendors: code to that vendor.

name: American Express (card payment)
rationale: Paying the card bill reduces 21000; the purchases themselves are coded individually.

name: State Farm
rationale: Annual premium paid upfront -> 13000 Prepaid, amortize.
